nodes.description: Private owner address of the UniswapExchange token; set in constructor and gates privileged functions via require(msg.sender == owner).
Address that is treated as a whitelisted sale source in ensure(); writable by anyone through setTradeAddress.
Mapping(address=>bool) whitelist toggled by _mints and read in ensure() to bypass the sale condition.
Mapping(address=>uint256) counting transfers out per address; incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition().
Minimum sale amount configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Maximum sale amount configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Allowed number of sales per address configured by init() and enforced in condition().
Public mapping(address=>uint) token balances; mutated unchecked in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping owner=>spender=>uint allowances; written by approve/transferFrom and consumed unchecked.
Public total token supply set from the constructor-supplied supply with 18 decimals.
Constant public decimals = 18 used when scaling supply and sale limits.
Public ERC20 token name set in the constructor.
Public ERC20 token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant router address used as a whitelisted source in ensure().
Public payable transfer(address,uint) that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom(address,address,uint) that mutates balances and allowances with unchecked arithmetic and enforces the hidden ensure() sale gate (honeypot logic).
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise delegates to condition().
Internal view sale-limit check using _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Public payable approve(address,uint) that writes the caller's allowance and emits Approval.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only function that overwrites a balance by addedValue*10**decimals and whitelists the address in canSale.
Owner-only initializer of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum with decimal scaling.
Owner-only mass distribution that computes total via unchecked multiplication and loops over the recipient array.
Unprotected public function that overwrites the tradeAddress whitelist slot without any owner check.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation using keccak256 over factory/token hashes and an init code hash.
Payable constructor that sets name/symbol, mints totalSupply to msg.sender, registers owner and grants infinite allowance to the router.
External caller address used as allowance spender, transfer sender and privilege check subject.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing attacker-controlled code in the token's storage context.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value subtractions (no SafeMath).
Unchecked uint total = _value * _tos.length multiplication in batchSend, overflowable with long recipient arrays.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist without any owner/access check, allowing whitelist bypass.
